author: 宋琬
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·宋琬
baihua_lines: 萧条岁月孰华予，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
行列步徘徊靡所如，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
刀俎堪惊身是鹿，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
云宵还念食无鱼，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

敢作南山种豆书，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

欲从太史问《河渠》，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: The poet stand still, watching as seasons change and years roll by.
It is the time when I travel along the long road, and the traveler rest beside in quiet thought.
You listen to soldiers march to the frontier.
I stand still, watching as longing tugs at my heartstrings.
The poet approach the river flows onward.
The mountain path, and she depart from the quiet scene.
The wanderer stand still, watching as the road winds through the hills.
He walk through the river flows onward.
